details.description: Llama 4 Maverick is Meta's flagship Llama 4 chat model, released April 5, 2025. It uses a mixture-of-experts architecture with 17 billion active parameters across 128 experts (400 billion total parameters), and Meta pretrained it on roughly 200 languages, including more than 100 with over a billion tokens each. It serves chat completions with a 131,072-token context window. Meta reports it exceeds GPT-4o and Gemini 2.0 Flash on coding, reasoning, multilingual, and long-context benchmarks, and is competitive with DeepSeek v3 on reasoning and coding.
advantages: Scores 80.5 on MMLU Pro, 69.8 on GPQA Diamond, and 43.4% pass@1 on LiveCodeBench, per its Hugging Face model card.
Scores 84.6 on Multilingual MMLU, per Meta's official Llama 4 model page.
Meta reports it exceeds GPT-4o and Gemini 2.0 Flash on coding, reasoning, multilingual, and long-context benchmarks, and is competitive with DeepSeek v3 on reasoning and coding.
Pretrained on roughly 200 languages, including more than 100 with over a billion tokens each -- about 10x the multilingual training tokens Meta used for Llama 3, per Meta's launch post.
disadvantages: Static model with an August 2024 knowledge cutoff, per its model card.
use_cases: Multilingual text generation and instruction following

sources.title: The Llama 4 herd: The beginning of a new era of natively multimodal AI innovation

notes: Catalog facts list a 131,072-token context window and text-only (text_input/text_output) modality for this entry, so that is what I described. Meta's own pages describe the base Llama 4 Maverick model as natively multimodal (text + image input, tested with up to 8 images) with a 1,048,576-token (~1M) context window -- both notably larger/different than the catalog facts. Kept the catalog's values per instructions; flagging the gap for review. Language list (12 names) and the 'pretrained on ~200 languages' figure both come from Meta's own sources and describe two different things (officially supported chat languages vs. pretraining-corpus diversity), so both are included.
